purpose: Names the DEVELOPMENT-only gold label fixture the F4 scorer may read, and the exact conditions under which it was produced. It authorises no inference and configures none: it exists so that a scoring run can be given gold WITHOUT editing the inference freeze that attempt 1 actually ran under.

declarations.scoringOnly: This document is read by the scorer and by nothing else. No runner, no prompt, no classifier configuration and no production module may load it.
declarations.createdAfterInference: Written on 2026-09-14, after attempt 1 completed on 2026-09-13 and after its authorisation was consumed. It did not exist while inference ran.
declarations.notVisibleToTheModel: Neither this file nor the label fixture it names was part of any prompt, any assembled batch input or any child process environment during attempt 1. The 24 final input identities pinned by the freeze are unchanged and still reproduce.
declarations.doesNotAlterF0B: The F0B inference freeze is byte-unchanged. No label path and no label hash was added to it, because a changed freeze hash would falsely imply that attempt 1 ran under a configuration carrying gold labels.

preservedAttempt.rerunPolicy: Scoring re-reads these preserved artifacts. No new inference, no attempt 2 and no new execution authorisation is created or implied by this supplement.

scope.onlyTheseGoldIdsMayAppear: Exactly the 49 ids below, taken from the approved canonical DEVELOPMENT corpus in its own line order. Any other id in the fixture is a contract breach and fails the projector.
scope.noHoldoutContent: No HOLDOUT gold id, label, verdict, rationale, ambiguity, url, title or organisation name appears in this supplement, in the label fixture, in the fixture manifest or in any scoring output derived from them.

labelFixture.populationRule: recordCount, rawSha256 and manifestRawSha256 stay null until the owner-authorised projection has run. A scorer presented with a null hash here must fail closed.

accessContract: The allowlist of 49 DEVELOPMENT gold ids is built only from the approved canonical corpus.
The source is read as a byte stream, one JSONL record at a time.
A record’s top-level goldId is extracted token-wise, before any deserialization.
A record is deserialized and schema-validated ONLY if its goldId is on the allowlist.
A non-allowlisted record is discarded immediately: not stored, counted, logged or emitted.
No HOLDOUT id set is built, and the source’s total record count is not measured.
The only figures taken over non-DEVELOPMENT bytes are the whole-file SHA-256 and the proof that each of the 49 allowlisted ids appeared exactly once.
Selected records are emitted as their ORIGINAL bytes, in canonical corpus order, with no adjudication, correction, normalisation or inference.

unresolvedGold.treatment: The F0B policy is unchanged and binds here: include the item in primary metrics using its committed label, report a leave-one-out view that removes only it, and never select whichever reading flatters a prompt variant. This supplement adjudicates nothing.

prohibitions: This supplement never becomes an input to inference.
This supplement never edits, supersedes or re-versions the F0B inference freeze.
The label fixture is never imported by production code.
No gold label is corrected, normalised or invented anywhere in this task.
